# Vendored browser runtime

- Egret Engine community rebuild, branch main, pinned commit [b6a392a61348a5ba53a48a0d4fbed514ffd87afe](https://github.com/cnedwin/Egret_rebuild/tree/b6a392a61348a5ba53a48a0d4fbed514ffd87afe).
- The contracts, runtime and engine packages were built from that Git checkout (tree a0f65aaca30e4f90e229eacdebe9bf847cfc73c5).
- Built with Node.js 26.7.0 and TypeScript 7.0.2 using upstream `node tools/build.mjs`.
- robust-predicates 3.0.3 is the engine dependency. The original license is retained next to the package.
